name: Daisuki na Goshujin-sama ni H na Gohoushi Shichau Maid Kissa no Midara na Yatoware Maid-tachi
original_name: 大好きなご主人様にHなご奉仕しちゃうメイド喫茶の淫らな雇われメイド達
source:
Raising the perfect maid, running the perfect maid cafe.

I've got a year to turn business around, or else my shop will be sold to Flowerbell!?

This is no joke. I need staff! Forgive me, but I can't work under another person!

Ah, that's right, the fashion these days is "Maid Cafes". If I get some maids in here my three-point meals are no problem.

I'll teach the right girls everything about maiding, and create the perfect shop!

Look out Flowerbell, my shop is going to rise from the ashes like a phoenix as a maid cafe! 


[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE062329.html]English DLSite[/url]]
